betting_description: An opposing player deals you three categories, drawn at random - they never choose them and can't steer you. You pick one, then bet on how hard a question you can take on it. Get it right and you keep the turn and bank the points below; get it wrong and it costs you, and the turn passes on.
betting_rules: The lowest tier can only be played three times in a row before the turn passes on regardless. First team to {{target}} wins outright.
